sources.title: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 - VRAM, Specs & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: About Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 is Mistral AI's foundational instruction-tuned model engineered for efficient conversational assistance and question answering. It incorporates Sliding-Window Attention and Grouped-Query Attention for fast inference.

sources.title: Model Card for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1
sources.snippet: The Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a instruct fine-tuned version of the Mistral-7B-v0.1 generative text model using a variety of publicly available conversation datasets.
